s2.priority: blocked targets before ordinary route order

s3.target: legal farthest enemy in base range
s3.center: immediate source position, followTarget=0; survives input death
s3.pulseDamage: selected atk_scale Arts; selected force pulls to fixed center
s3.finalShift: zero-damage .3s center pull followed by 1s front pull, .5 source offset
s3.hud: 9-second field countdown begins at original Startup hit, zero during finishing hook; source table still displays duration=8

waves.recovery: selected HP recovery ratio; deployment-owned aura

verificationLimits: Playable adapter, not native FSM execution or frame/particle parity. Original components, tables, colliders, templates and SkeletonDataAsset bindings are retained for independent review.

S3 source table duration=8 differs from projectile_delay_time/hit_duration=9 and 10-second linked holders. The adapter uses original Startup hit then the 9-second projectile window, six immediate/1.5-second pulses and final Begin/link/End; native SequenceAbility has repeated FinalAttack entries and its compiled handoff/escape-time behavior is not certified.

Original final hook is represented by two scheduled shift calls (.3 and 1 seconds) on current 1-radius occupants. Native .5-second whirlpool pull interpolation, velocities, collision integration, random final offsets and exact physics are not certified; the existing stage displacement solver remains in use.

S1/S2 retain native projectile speed, selected force, one-second linked cast and minimum postdelay/original End. Exact invisible-target refunds, early-end-idle and native abnormal interruption handoffs still require client comparison.
Modules are not enabled. No source particle, trail, sound, light or whirlpool mesh is claimed rendered; original effect identifiers are evidence rather than reconstructed native effects.
Sea Monster damage reduction is tested with source-tagged synthetic attackers. Stage 0-1 contains only its existing two basic enemy types; this batch does not enable new stages/enemies.
